title: Late-shipment 3.4% ↑ — 0.6pp from threshold
narrative: Operational fixes run first — the recovery curve is the strongest evidence a submission can carry. Filings go out only after the fix is live, and only by a person.
status_note: Execute · 0 of 4 stages · submissions wait for the fix to go live

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, a stress window raises a card and waits for you.

plan.name: Operational fixes
plan.meta: handling-time buffer and Monday roster · nothing submitted to anyone

items.name: Handling-time buffer on weekend orders
items.detail: One extra day on Fri–Sun orders, applied in the OMS ahead of anything being filed. The recovery curve starts from the moment this lands, which is what the submissions cite.

items.name: Two extra Monday pickers at the East node
items.detail: Requested with the 3PL for the oversize queue. Addresses the 11% that waits on a second picker without touching the promise shown at checkout.

items.name: Zone 7–8 routing already live
items.detail: Rule set v14 moved Zone 7–8 orders to the West node last week. It is already contributing to the Walmart on-time recovery.

plan.name: Submissions
plan.meta: 2 filings · case IDs tracked from acknowledgement

items.name: IP counter-notice · case 8814-2291
items.detail: R. Vance read the pack and filed at 09:20. Amazon acknowledged with a 5–9 business-day review window. The listing stays suppressed until it resolves.

items.name: Walmart content reinstatement · WM-40118
items.detail: All nine listings corrected including the seven not yet flagged, then the reinstatement request filed with the diff as evidence. A. Castellanos sent it.

items.name: Authenticity documents · case 8791-4402
items.detail: Three invoices and three authorisation letters pulled with current expiry dates, read and submitted. Eleven days of window remained.

plan.name: Vault and expiry tracking
plan.meta: documents indexed · 2 certifications expiring inside 60 days

items.name: Submitted documents indexed
items.detail: Everything sent today is filed against its case with the submission timestamp, so a follow-up request is answered from the record rather than reassembled.

items.name: Two certifications expiring
items.detail: A food-contact certificate and a lab report both lapse within 60 days. Nothing depends on them today, which is exactly when to renew them.

items.name: Renewal tasks created
items.detail: Two tasks with owners and dates, timed to complete before expiry rather than after a marketplace asks.

plan.name: Monitoring and prevention
plan.meta: recovery curves, case polling, recurrence watch, preventive rule

items.name: Recovery curves armed
items.detail: Late shipment and Walmart on-time both read daily against the projection. A miss of more than 0.3pp for two days re-opens this card.

items.name: Case polling every 4 hours
items.detail: Three open cases polled for status change. A response from either marketplace wakes the card with the clock recalculated.

items.name: Event written to the pattern library
items.detail: Cause, response, timings and outcome recorded. The next late-shipment drift opens with this event attached rather than as a new investigation.
